steps.text: Position the low speed weights. identified by the long cam arm. on opposite sides of the weight carrier. Drive the weight pins in place and install the retaining rings. To install a weight pin correctly, push the grooved end through the smaller hole in the carrier and through the weight. Then. drive the knurled end in just enough so the retaining ring can be installed on the pin.
